'''''Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel''''',<ref name="swcom" /> codenamed "'''Tanner''',"<ref name="Tanner">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/761124/tanner-by-random-house-worlds|text=Untitled Star Wars August Novel|nolive=yes}}</ref> is a novel written by [[Lamar Giles]] and released as a hardcover and ebook by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[August 5]], [[2025]]. An [[Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel (audiobook)|audio version]] was released on the same day.<ref name="Penguin" /> It is set during [[The Bad Batch Season 2|season two]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', after the events of the season's thirteenth episode "[[Pabu (episode)|Pabu]]."<ref name="swcom" />
